question: KL42 is related to PQ50 in a certain way. In the same way, RS52 is related to WX60. To which of the following is DE62 related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed in this pattern involves a consistent alphabetical shift for the letters and an arithmetic operation for the number:

 
• For both **letters**, they shift **+5** positions forward in the English alphabetical order.
 
• For the **number**, it increases by **+8**.
